assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original painted theme illustration for the right-hand art panel of a student presentation website, square composition.
Primary request: an exquisite, peaceful watercolor coastal reading scene with a sea-salt morning atmosphere. Foreground: a sunlit ivory wooden reading table at an open seaside reading nook, with a beautifully painted open book with BLANK pages, two simple closed books without lettering, and one small seashell. Beyond it, translucent sea-salt teal ocean waves roll onto pale ivory sand; airy white clouds float in a soft clear sky. A few restrained navy-blue details on the book binding and distant shoreline give depth.
Style/medium: refined hand-painted watercolor and gouache illustration, delicate paper grain, transparent pigment washes, soft organic brushwork, controlled crisp detail on the book and shell, art-book quality rather than flat vector or photography.
Lighting/mood: gentle luminous daylight, airy and calm, warm reflected light on the table, inviting reading atmosphere.
Color palette: sea-salt pale teal, muted turquoise, ivory sand, soft cloud white, sparing dark navy blue.
Composition/framing: square full-bleed artwork, with the reading table in the lower third and the sea/clouds providing breathing room above; main shapes clustered near the center so it also crops gracefully into a vertical website illustration panel. Clear depth from foreground books to distant shore, no busy clutter.
Constraints: NO people, animals, characters, readable text, letters, book titles, numerals, UI, screens, labels, frame, logo or watermark. The open book has blank gently shaded pages. This is only the illustration asset, not a webpage mockup.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original painted theme illustration for the right-hand art panel of a student presentation website, square composition.
Primary request: a dreamy celestial reading room that feels like a tiny moonlit theater. A luminous crescent moon hangs centrally above an open blank-page book on a small reading stand, within an intimate curved observatory alcove. Suggest layered theater curtains and arched architectural depth in the surrounding darkness, a few quiet star lights, and gently illuminated closed books with no lettering. The crescent moon, book and their reflected light are the three clear focal elements.
Style/medium: exquisite gouache and watercolor storybook illustration, rich matte painted texture, delicate pigment grain, nuanced layered light, restrained fine brush details, painterly art-book finish rather than photorealism or vector graphics.
Lighting/mood: poetic, still and luminous; warm antique-gold crescent light washes softly across lavender book pages, while indigo and plum shadows recede in layers. Dreamlike but readable at website-panel scale.
Color palette: very deep ink navy, muted plum purple, antique gold, pale lavender, small warm cream highlights.
Composition/framing: square full-bleed composition that also crops gracefully as a vertical panel. Keep crescent and open book comfortably inside the central 65% of width. Arching forms and curtain folds frame the central light without any hard border; enough quiet dark breathing room around the scene.
Constraints: NO people, animals, characters, text, lettering, numerals, constellations with labels, UI, screens, logo or watermark. All book pages and spines have no letters. This is a standalone illustration, not a webpage or poster mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D desktop pet sprite sheet, PNG.
Create ONE SQUARE image with genuine transparent RGBA alpha, containing exactly FOUR full-body frames in an exact invisible 2x2 grid of four equally sized square cells. Absolutely no painted background, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no border, no labels, no text and no scenery.
Subject: an ORIGINAL adorable creamy-white moon rabbit, same identity and proportions across all four frames: soft rounded little body, two gently upright rabbit ears, small expressive dark indigo eyes, subtle pale lavender shading, a tiny indigo-blue scarf, and a small antique-gold star brooch on the scarf. Refined charming hand-painted storybook style, clean legible silhouette, delicate soft texture and expressive tiny paws. Not an existing character or IP, not photorealistic.
EXACT frame order: TOP LEFT idle: standing quietly with a friendly CLOSED-mouth smile, paws relaxed. TOP RIGHT talking: visibly OPEN mouth, one little paw making an explanatory gesture. BOTTOM LEFT pointing: one paw raised pointing clearly toward the UPPER LEFT as if teaching. BOTTOM RIGHT happy: BOTH paws raised joyfully, cheerful expression.
CRITICAL layout: all four full-body rabbits centered horizontally within their own equal-sized cell. Use identical body scale and viewing angle. Every rabbit must stand on EXACTLY the same relative baseline at 82% of its cell height, including the bottom-row poses. Both ears, raised paws, scarf and both feet must remain inside each cell. Entire nontransparent rabbit silhouette must be no more than 62% of each cell's width and no more than 62% of its height, leaving ample fully transparent padding on all four sides. No part crosses the horizontal or vertical midpoint of the whole sheet. No oversized ears or gestures extending beyond the safe silhouette area.
Preserve actual alpha transparency, with zero alpha outside the four clean character silhouettes. No floor shadows, loose sparkles, dust, halos, translucent background residue, decorative stars floating outside the character, or other detached props. Same four poses, exact 2x2 equal-cell registration, clean transparent PNG.
